conversation.text: You said training left you poorly prepared. What is happening?

Training was just one slide deck and my buddy has been too busy with month-end, so I learned invoice posting from YouTube and ended up posting three invoices to the wrong cost centre last week. A 2-hour hands-on SAP session with real cases would really help.

Here is what I will tell HR: The new hire reported that training consisted of a single slide deck and required independent learning to complete tasks.
